O God, always among the gods.
may we meditate upon all your beautiful gifts.
He who, as the Hotṛ-priest, bestows all wealth.
The hymns go forth to Agni.
The horse, the chariot-steed, with hymns— [we invoke him],
O Lord of the People, bring across the wealth of the liberal patrons.
Sing forth to the most bountiful one,
the upholder of the Cosmic Order!
to Agni— may we offer our praises.
The bounteous one will win glory accompanied by heroic sons.
He who is the one who has risen up, the one who has settled down, the one who knows.
May the one worthy of sacrifice bring hither the wealth.

May the guest, the Vasu, not strike us down.
He who is the excellent invoker,
the performer of the perfect sacrifice.
may those who harm us with their incantations be destroyed.
I implore you for the office of messenger.
He for whom the oblation is offered at night;
he who makes the sacrifice successful.
O Agni, come as a friend of the Maruts, together with the Rudras.
For the drinking of Soma; of Sobhari; hither.
